name: task-orchestrator
description: Makes the session a lead coordinator: worker profiles with an explicit model and effort per task class, dispatched as real isolated subagents under enforced concurrency, nesting, retry and writer-overlap limits, writers always (so the write fence sees their calls) and other workers where auto mode cannot judge a plugin's spawn handed to the coordinator's own Agent call, with requested versus observed settings reported in SIGMAorbital panels.
